caption: The image is a drawing of a lion rendered in shades of yellow, brown, and tan. The lion is depicted in profile view facing to the right, with its mouth open and showing its white teeth and a part of its pink tongue. The lion's mane is full and detailed, covering most of its neck and extending down its shoulders in wavy, textured strands colored in darker shades of brown compared to the lighter yellow-tan of its body. The lion is in a crouching pose, with its front right leg bent and lifted slightly off the ground, and its rear left leg stretched back. The claws on its paws are visible. The background is a solid, light tan color with no additional objects or features, making the lion the only subject in the composition.
title: Circus Wagon Lion
